title: Mission — Data-Only Movie Protocol
excerpt: B"H Boruch Hashem Blessed is He Mission — Data Only Movie Protocol The Awtsmoos renews every frame while data names each vessel exactly; Awtsmoos.com must render what an agent declares, never guess what human language means indirectly. Non negotiable invariant The movie maker must never parse, classify, infer, or inter
searchText: b"h boruch hashem blessed is he mission — data only movie protocol the awtsmoos renews every frame while data names each vessel exactly; awtsmoos.com must render what an agent declares, never guess what human language means indirectly. non negotiable invariant the movie maker must never parse, classify, infer, or interpret english or any other natural language. external ai agents or ordinary programs create explicit canonical movie data. the movie maker only: 1. migrates versioned data, 2. validates it, 3. normalizes mechanical defaults, 4. applies explicit machine patches, 5. projects it through app adapters, 6. previews/renders/exports it. no prompt to movie fallback, regex semantics, keyword cameras, prose feature inference, or internal ai provider abstraction belongs inside the movie maker. completion gates public api exposes a stable machine authored contract. ui accepts/imports canonical json/data instead of prose prompts. revisions are explicit patch arrays/data only. app installers do not inject ai providers. prompt/nlp modules are not reachable from the public movie runtime. tests prove arbitrary structured movie data renders without any text interpretation. existing 2d/3d adapters, three minute showcase, mobile ux, export, and validation remain working.

title: First Critique — Twenty Corrections
excerpt: B"H Boruch Hashem Blessed is He First Critique — Twenty Corrections The Awtsmoos burns away ambiguity; Awtsmoos.com lets each contract stand plain; these twenty gates prevent hidden prompt logic from returning through another name again. 1. Literal text layers must remain legal; only semantic inference from text is for
searchText: b"h boruch hashem blessed is he first critique — twenty corrections the awtsmoos burns away ambiguity; awtsmoos.com lets each contract stand plain; these twenty gates prevent hidden prompt logic from returning through another name again. 1. literal text layers must remain legal; only semantic inference from text is forbidden. 2. json parsing is syntax processing, not natural language interpretation. 3. validation errors should use codes and paths usable by agents. 4. mechanical defaults may fill omitted numeric/structural fields but must not invent story semantics. 5. unknown extension metadata should survive round trips when safe. 6. schema version must be explicit. 7. public exports must stop advertising prompt/provider apis. 8. runtime option objects must stop accepting provider callbacks. 9. app installers must stop reading awtsmoosmovieaiprovider globals. 10. revision must accept explicit patch data only. 11. ui should say data/import, not prompt/generate. 12. external agents need a programmatic load entrypoint, not just a textarea. 13. external agents need capability discovery. 14. tests must grep/runtime check that prompt interpretation modules are unreachable. 15. existing showcase data must continue to validate/render. 16. existing adapters must receive canonical movie objects unchanged semantically. 17. mobile ui must retain import/edit/preview usability. 18. data import must reject malformed json without mutating current movie. 19. data import must reject schema invalid objects with actionable paths. 20. text strings such as orbit inside captions must never alter camera behavior.

title: Improved Plan

Architecture Use the existing canonical protocol/validator/runtime as the center. Replace the AI/pro
searchText: b"h boruch hashem blessed is he improved plan the awtsmoos gives the agent freedom to imagine, the engine discipline to obey; awtsmoos.com receives declared data only, then renders the declaration without semantic sway. architecture use the existing canonical protocol/validator/runtime as the center. replace the ai/prompt façade with a data director façade: moviedataruntime installs ui/api. moviedatastate imports canonical objects and applies explicit patches. moviedatapanel accepts canonical json for humans/debuggers and exposes import/export. movieagentbridge exposes a stable programmatic interface and event ingestion for external agents. storyboard/timeline/canvas/export panels continue observing the same canonical state. the external ai agent is outside the repository boundary: it can read the contract/capabilities and submit a complete movie object or explicit patch list. migration strategy 1. read every current prompt/provider call site. 2. reuse canonical migration/validation/patch modules. 3. add data only state/bridge/panel in small files. 4. rewire dock/runtime/installers. 5. remove prompt/provider exports and unused runtime modules only after proving no call sites remain. 6. rewrite tests around structured data. 7. browser test direct object injection and json import across product surfaces.
